decisions.authorization_quote: for Meta, I approve all 5 of the preferred treatments; For Alphabet, i approve the preferred treatments for both issues
decisions.authorization_source: Explicit user approval and instruction to implement and log treatments in this Valuation Platform conversation.

decisions.original_issue: Unclassified Other financing and separately reported finance-lease principal.
decisions.treatment: Reconcile every financing row, include disclosed borrowing/lease principal once, research Other using primary commentary; keep residual unclassified and FCFE provisional.

decisions.original_issue: Original gross and later net cash PP&E presentations differ.
decisions.treatment: Use cash PP&E net of identified asset-sale receipts: subtract245M in2022 and221M in2023; replay later comparisons, preserve2021net18,567M. Do not infer receipts inside mixed investing lines.

decisions.original_issue: Later FY2021 Other+1M hides original overdraft+14M and Other−13M.
decisions.treatment: Preserve identified overdraft borrowing14M once; reconcile14−13=1 without reclassifying the residual.

decisions.original_issue: FY2021/22 gross expense was absent in original source vintage.
decisions.treatment: Use exact23M/185M from FY2023 comparative Note14; retain target annual dates and later source identity, no coupon or cash-interest proxy.

decisions.original_issue: FY2025 tax charge15,930M contains noncash valuation allowance14,030M; provision and cash taxes differ.
decisions.treatment: Preserve reported historical tax/CFO; do not add accounting charges to cash or choose a recurring forecast rate. Keep EBIT-route diagnostic separate.

limitations: Historical CFO basis differs from SBC-expensed EBIT forecast and finance-asset investment scope.
Reported provision/pretax is an explicit historical tax allocation, not a recurring forecast rate.
Other financing unresolved; full FCFE not certified.

fcfe.formula: reported CFO - cash PP&E net of identified receipts + identified net borrowing

fcff.formula: reported CFO + reported interest expense * (1 - reported tax provision / reported pretax income) - cash PP&E
fcff.precision_notice: Exact arithmetic on reported rounded points; extra calculated digits do not improve filing precision.
fcff.tax_notice: Reported ETR is the named allocation convention, not a separately disclosed unlevered cash-tax rate or actual interest tax shield.
